summary: Add the column with a database default first, deploy state-only, drop the default after the old version is retired.

stages.description: Metadata-only on Postgres 11+: NOT NULL with a constant default.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false

stages.description: Deploy the new version; its migration only updates Django state.
The new version always sends a value; the database default is no longer needed.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in DROP DEFAULT
